steps.content: The strange light in the sky becomes more pronounced, twisting and turning, signaling that Mania is intensifying. It's unclear when it will completely break through the boundary into this world.

Meanwhile, your battle is entirely one-sided. 000 effortlessly neutralizes all your efforts, as if she's just passing the time. Under the wrath of her permissions, the Sinners can't even use their powers.
Hey, I already told you to be cautious when fighting here. You'll get discovered.
The force restraining you suddenly lifts, and 000's body flickers. She hasn't been attacked, but she pauses as if her consciousness is interrupted, and her eyes suddenly turn hollow.
At the same time, you hear another familiar soft voice.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Phew... looks like I made it in time.
A blue data matrix unfolds before you, shielding you from all attacks. Inside the matrix, Moore's projection appears before you.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Chief, are you alright? I've been too busy handling data to contact you. I was worried you might be pushing yourself too hard and had gotten into trouble.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: But now, it seems the timing is just right.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Thanks for buying me time. The virus developed against the anomalous Sinner 000 has been successfully implanted in the target. The repair process has started, and the threat she poses will soon be neutralized.
